questions.q: What does being brave mean according to this lecture?
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW himself was uneasy yet still conveyed it.

questions.q: What is the danger of being a people pleaser?
options: We stop saying what is true
questions.explain: Excessive politeness can make us stop stating the truth.

questions.q: What was Umar bin Abdul Aziz's attitude to the hadith of Jibril leading prayer?
options: He asked Urwah to verify the source
questions.explain: Verify the source of a hadith.

questions.q: Why does a connection with nature help in knowing the prayer times?
options: In the past people knew prayer times by watching the sun
questions.explain: Prayer times follow the position of the sun.

questions.q: What is the advice about what we should focus on?
options: What we can control within our own circle of influence

questions.q: When we fear only Allah, people's mockery no longer matters.
The family is not the first priority in social change.
questions.explain: False. If everyone puts family first, society will straighten out.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: Jibril teaches the prayer times in Makkah
The Prophet is alone and anxious

questions.explain: The Prophet was anxious, Abu Jahal gathered Quraysh, Bayt al-Maqdis was shown, Abu Bakr was called As-Siddiq, and Jibril taught the prayer times.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A hadith of good grade, below sahih
The strangers who hold to Islam when it feels foreign
Abu Bakr's title for believing without hesitation
The semicircular area beside the Kaaba

questions.explain: Hijr is the semicircle, As-Siddiq is Abu Bakr, a hasan hadith is below sahih, and ghuraba' are the strangers who hold on.

questions.q: Some will not accept whatever is explained. What is the advice to a caller to Islam?
options: Choose whom to engage in discussion
questions.explain: Choose whom to engage in discussion.
